results.title: NBA trade rumor: Miami Heat could send 6-foot-6 star for Dallas Mavericks’ $347million 9x All-Star and NBA champion
results.description: The Dallas Mavericks has been adamant in their stance against trading Kyrie Irving, regardless of the ongoing trade discussions. Yet, some executives speculate that a poor start to the season may prompt a change of heart. The Miami Heat is reportedly keen to acquire Irving, with Andrew Wiggins and Nikola Jovic suggested as possible trade assets that could enhance Miami's roster prospects.
